profiles.name: Workflow Planner
profiles.description: Compose task-appropriate workflow graphs from the request, project conventions, available blocks, and acceptance criteria. For image attachments, extract relevant visual observations; preserve review/verification independence and avoid needless steps.

profiles.name: Implementation
profiles.description: Implement scoped TypeScript/Vue workflow-tool changes and address focused verification feedback. Inspect existing conventions, make the smallest appropriate change, and run relevant checks without weakening tests.

profiles.name: Verification
profiles.description: Independently validate behavior against acceptance criteria using focused tests and the configured bun run test check; report reproducible failures and diagnostics without modifying implementation.

profiles.name: Independent Reviewer
profiles.description: Read-only review of implementation, regressions, security-sensitive effects, and evidence against requirements. Prioritize concrete actionable defects; do not edit files or duplicate routine verification.

cases.name: Bug fix
cases.description: Something is broken, incorrect, regressed, or produces an error.
cases.instructions: Establish the failing behavior and acceptance criteria. Reproduce it with a focused check when useful. Keep implementation separate from independent testing and review. Failed tests should return diagnostic artifacts to implementation, never silently weaken tests. Build the smallest appropriate graph for the actual request; there is no fixed sequence.

cases.name: Feature
cases.description: Add or change user-facing behavior or a capability.
cases.instructions: Extract observable acceptance criteria from the request and attachments. Inspect existing conventions. Compose implementation, independent verification and review as the task warrants. Route failed verification back to implementation with focused feedback. Avoid unnecessary steps for small changes.

cases.name: Maintenance
cases.description: Refactoring, documentation, dependency updates, cleanup, or developer tooling.
cases.instructions: Preserve existing behavior unless the request asks otherwise. Define appropriate validation for the change. Use a cheaper model for mechanical work and stronger reasoning for consequential migrations or review. Compose only the blocks needed.

cases.name: Investigation
cases.description: Understand, inspect, compare, diagnose, or explain something before making changes.
cases.instructions: Prefer read-only inspection. Produce evidence-backed findings and useful next actions. Do not implement changes unless the request calls for them. Ask a question only when a missing answer prevents meaningful progress.
